t: The Matter Receiver is where a player can teleport too from a $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_transmitter)Matter Transmitter$(/l). Use the $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/dialing_device)Dialing Device$(/l) to dial a matter transmitter to this receiver.$(br2)$(5)Infusing$() this machine causes reduced power consumption
物质接收器是玩家可通过$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_transmitter)物质传输器$(/l)传送抵达的位置。请使用$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/dialing_device)坐标记录仪$(/l)将物质传输器拨号至该接收器。$(br2)$(5)注魔$()该机器可降低能耗。
Note that it is very important that the Matter Receiver has enough power. If not the player risks bad effects when teleporting
注意，物质接收器拥有足够能量非常重要。否则玩家在传送时可能会遭受不良效果。
